pr_title: drivers: adc: added support adc driver for lpcexpresso55s69
pr_body:
Added shim driver for the LPADC for lpcexpresso55s69 board.

Fixes #22703.

Signed-off-by: Toby Firth <tobyjfirth@gmail.com>
pr_comments: I have the changes for the things that @anangl brought up. I have added some comments to explain some of the behaviour around the 16-bit and 12/13-bit support in the lpadc library.

issue_context.title: Implement ADC driver for lpcxpresso55s69
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
The `lpcxpresso55s69` board currently lacks support for ADC in zephyr.

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Implement a shim driver that adapts the mcux lpc ADC driver to the zephyr ADC interface. The existing `adc_mcux_adc12.c` and `adc_mcux_adc16.c` shim drivers for kinetis and i.mx rt can be used for reference. Enable `tests/drivers/adc` for this board to ensure the ADC driver builds and functions correctly.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
N/A
comments: I have created a pull request that adds the driver shim for the lpadc. The ADC tests are all passing. I have tried using the driver to read from the internal temperature sensor but I don't seem to be able to get expected temperature values. I think this is probably dues to not altering the board correctly as the user manual and the readme.txt in the example code from the SDK. This could also be to not setting the external voltage reference up correctly.

review_comments: If I understand it correctly, the 13-bit resolution case is handled here, but what about the 12-bit one?

The 12-bit case is also handled as the msb is always 0.
Hopefully this screenshot from the documentation shows what I mean and why the 12-bit case is handled here.
